lines.text: Jesus was baptized along with all the people, and as He was praying, heaven was opened.
The Holy Spirit descended on Jesus in a bodily form like a flame.
A voice from heaven said Jesus was its beloved Son, in whom it was well pleased.
Jesus was about forty years old when He began His ministry.
Jesus was regarded as the son of Joseph, and His family line runs back through David and Abraham to Adam, the son of God.
